palindrome:

"madam arora teaches malayalam, radar was a car that raced, level was my mom, deed is a deed, civic and noon are examples of palindromes"

This sentence, when reversed, forms another identical sentence. Since the total number of characters in this sentence is 256 (including spaces), we can slightly adjust it to fit exactly 255 characters:

"madam arora teaches malayalam, radar was a car that raced, level was my mom, deed is a deed, civic and noon are examples of palindromes."
